record_type_quote:
The claim selected for replication from Lai and Poletiek (2011) was from their
Experiment 1: when participants were exposed to the set of same strings, generated by an
AnBn grammar, the ordering of the exemplars affected learning: in the ‘starting small’ (SS)
condition, syllable strings were presented progressively according to their level of embedding,
while in the random condition, exactly the same set was presented randomly, and the SS group
outperformed the random group.
